purpose: Give an approximation or emphasize a broad general judgment.
keywords: express feelings speak politely show respect
およそ + quantity; およそ … negative; およそ + general category
It is approximately two kilometers to the station.
That story has absolutely nothing to do with reality.
formation: およそ + quantity; およそ … negative; およそ + general category
restrictions: The meaning depends on whether a quantity or judgment follows.
mistake: With a negative it can mean entirely, not approximately.
